title: Natural proofs for quantum state preparation lower bounds
summary: We identify a barrier that helps explain why proving stronger quantum state-preparation lower bounds has been so difficult. In particular, we establish a quantum analogue of the Razborov-Rudich natural proofs barrier for state-preparation lower bounds. We call a property of quantum states \emph{natural} if it holds for a sufficiently large fraction of Haar-random states and can be efficiently tested when given all of the state's amplitudes.
